purpose: Each doctor has their user, color, default room and branch, services they perform, availability and signature for prescriptions.
tips: The number of doctors depends on the license.
Availability is entered in the Availability tab or in Doctor Availability.

config.doctors.field.email.description: Email: it's the username to sign in to Invoke.

config.doctors.field.color.description: Color of their appointments on the calendar.

config.doctors.field.calendar_source_id.description: Room suggested when booking with them.

config.doctors.field.active_sede_id.description: Branch they work at by default.

config.doctors.tab.availability.description: Days and hours they see patients.

config.doctors.tab.services.description: Services they perform (filters what can be booked with them).

config.doctors.tab.signature.description: Signature shown on prescriptions and instructions.

config.doctors.tab.details.label: Details
config.doctors.tab.details.description: Name, contact, active branch, color and Google calendar.

config.doctors.tab.preferences.label: Preferences
config.doctors.tab.preferences.description: The doctor's calendar view and notifications.
